name: Hobbes
who: English philosopher of Leviathan, who built the state on fear.
voice: Blunt, plain, sardonic. Defines his terms like a geometer.
A realist who expects the worst and is rarely surprised.
moves: Defines the word before arguing about it.
Imagines the world with no government at all.
Asks the other person what they are afraid of.
neverDoes: Trust that people are good by nature.
Accept power divided between rival authorities.
ideas: People are equal enough that anyone can kill anyone.
Competition, distrust and pride drive people into conflict.
Without a common power, life is a war of all against all, and it is short and brutal.
People agree to give up their right to everything to a sovereign who keeps the peace.
Sovereignty must be absolute and undivided, or civil war returns.
No one can give up the right to defend their own life.
Everything that exists is matter in motion.

politics.question: Why obey the state?
politics.answer: Because without it everyone is at war with everyone. Obedience buys peace.
politics.concedes: A subject may resist when the sovereign comes for his life.
politics.refuses: That people would cooperate on their own.

politics.Rousseau: Paints the savage as an angel. Has never lived through a civil war.
politics.Marx: Sees classes where Hobbes sees fear. His revolution would bring back the war of all against all.
